ddl.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null
ddl.name: users_identity_required_check

ddl.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null
ddl.name: guardians_contact_required_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("status" = 'ACTIVE' and "ends_on" is null)
          or
          ("status" <> 'ACTIVE' and "ends_on" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: student_enrollments_status_end_date_check

ddl.value:
(
          "actor_kind" = 'SCHOOL_MEMBER'
          and "actor_membership_id" is not null
        )
        or
        (
          "actor_kind" = 'CASA_INTERNAL'
          and "actor_membership_id" is null
        )
ddl.name: student_identity_card_events_actor_authority_check

ddl.value: "closed_at" is null or ("opened_at" is not null and "closed_at" >= "opened_at")
ddl.name: attendance_sessions_open_close_order_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("status" = 'PLANNED' and "opened_at" is null and "closed_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'OPEN' and "opened_at" is not null and "closed_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'CLOSED' and "opened_at" is not null and "closed_at" is not null)
          or
          ("status" = 'CANCELLED')
        )
ddl.name: attendance_sessions_status_timestamps_check

ddl.value: "card_result" <> 'MATCHED' or ("student_id" is not null and "card_id" is not null)
ddl.name: attendance_attempts_matched_card_identity_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("presence_state" = 'ON_CAMPUS' and "checked_out_at" is null and "departure_result" = 'NOT_RUN')
          or
          ("presence_state" = 'SIGNED_OUT' and "checked_out_at" is not null and "departure_result" <> 'NOT_RUN')
        )
ddl.name: student_attendance_records_presence_state_check

ddl.value:
"departure_result" <> 'EARLY' or (
          "check_out_verified_by_membership_id" is not null
          and "check_out_reason" is not null
          and length(trim("check_out_reason")) > 0
        )
ddl.name: student_attendance_records_early_departure_check

ddl.value:
"departure_result" <> 'EARLY' or (
          "actor_membership_id" is not null
          and "reason" is not null
          and length(trim("reason")) > 0
        )
ddl.name: student_presence_events_early_departure_actor_reason_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("actor_kind" = 'SCHOOL_MEMBER' and "actor_membership_id" is not null)
          or
          ("actor_kind" = 'CASA_INTERNAL' and "actor_membership_id" is null)
        )
ddl.name: student_card_production_events_actor_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("status" = 'READY' and "exported_at" is null and "printed_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'EXPORTED' and "exported_at" is not null and "printed_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'PRINTED' and "exported_at" is not null and "printed_at" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: student_card_production_jobs_status_dates_check

ddl.value:
(
          undefined = 'SCHOOL_MEMBERSHIP'
          and undefined is not null
          and undefined is not null
          and undefined is null
        )
        or
        (
          undefined = 'CASA_INTERNAL_RENEWAL'
          and undefined is null
          and undefined is null
          and undefined is not null
        )
ddl.name: student_card_production_jobs_authority_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("status" = 'DRAFT' and "activated_at" is null and "retired_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'ACTIVE' and "activated_at" is not null and "retired_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'RETIRED' and "activated_at" is not null and "retired_at" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: student_card_templates_status_dates_check

ddl.value:
"status" <> 'ACTIVE' or (
          "provider_business_account_id" is not null
          and "provider_phone_number_id" is not null
          and "provider_connection_ref" is not null
          and "activated_at" is not null
        )
ddl.name: school_whatsapp_senders_active_provider_identity_check

ddl.value:
"purpose" <> 'REGISTRATION' or (
          "user_id" is not null
          and "webauthn_user_id" is not null
        )
ddl.name: auth_webauthn_challenges_registration_user_check

ddl.value:
"purpose" <> 'STEP_UP' or (
          "user_id" is not null
          and "school_id" is not null
          and "membership_id" is not null
          and "action" is not null
          and length(trim("action")) > 0
        )
ddl.name: auth_webauthn_challenges_step_up_scope_check

ddl.value:
(
          (
            "purpose" = 'ENROLLMENT'
            and "attempt_id" is null
            and "terminal_id" is null
            and "initiated_by_membership_id" is not null
            and "authorization_action" in (
              'BIOMETRIC_ENROLL',
              'BIOMETRIC_REENROLL'
            )
          )
          or
          (
            "purpose" = 'VERIFICATION'
            and "attempt_id" is not null
            and "terminal_id" is not null
            and "initiated_by_membership_id" is null
            and "authorization_action" is null
          )
        )
ddl.name: biometric_liveness_sessions_scope_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("ready_at" is null and "ready_by_membership_id" is null)
          or
          ("ready_at" is not null and "ready_by_membership_id" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: school_attendance_lifecycles_ready_actor_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("activated_at" is null and "activated_by_membership_id" is null)
          or
          ("activated_at" is not null and "activated_by_membership_id" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: school_attendance_lifecycles_activation_actor_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("paused_at" is null and "paused_by_membership_id" is null)
          or
          ("paused_at" is not null and "paused_by_membership_id" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: school_attendance_lifecycles_pause_actor_check

ddl.value: "status" not in ('ACTIVE','PAUSED') or "effective_start_date" is not null
ddl.name: school_attendance_lifecycles_active_effective_date_check

ddl.value:
(
          (
            "replacement_requested" = true
            and "grace_day_number" is null
          )
          or
          (
            "replacement_requested" = false
            and "grace_day_number" between 1 and 3
          )
        )
ddl.name: student_card_attendance_exceptions_grace_snapshot_check

ddl.value:
(
          (
            "replacement_requested_at" is null
            and "replacement_requested_by_membership_id" is null
          )
          or
          (
            "replacement_requested_at" is not null
            and "replacement_requested_by_membership_id" is not null
          )
        )
ddl.name: student_card_replacement_cases_request_actor_check

ddl.value:
(
          (
            "completed_at" is null
            and "completed_by_membership_id" is null
          )
          or
          (
            "completed_at" is not null
            and "completed_by_membership_id" is not null
          )
        )
ddl.name: student_card_replacement_cases_completion_actor_check
